answer: A juror that skips cases loses 26% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. Because the ember decay is applied at each close, the pulse audit shows the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A farm that parks keys in the jury pool as a result watches its influence decay while paying the forge fee to keep them eligible. A 275 account operation therefore ties up 8 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
